# JPEG 2000 test samples

These raw `JPXDecode` streams were extracted from the local integration PDF
`v5_second_inquisition_high-res__29744.pdf` with the user's permission.

The set contains four streams with different dimensions and compressed sizes.
`manifest.json` records their source object numbers, dimensions, byte lengths,
and SHA-256 hashes. The large source PDF is not part of the repository.

These samples cover one PDF producer only. Add independent JP2, raw J2K,
grayscale, RGB, CMYK, alpha, tiled, lossless, and malformed samples before
claiming broad JPEG 2000 compatibility.
